citation: Wilczynska A, Aigueperse C, Kress M, Dautry F, Weil D. The translational regulator CPEB1 provides a link between dcp1 bodies and stress granules. J Cell Sci. 2005;118:981-992.
evidence_notes: CPEB1 is experimentally associated with stress-granule and mRNA-storage biology. This provides general stress-response interpretability but is not direct evidence for desiccation in Ramazzottius varieornatus and does not validate an FSF direction.

citation: Wang H, Guan J, Wang H, Perrault AR, Wang Y, Iliakis G. Replication protein A2 phosphorylation after DNA damage by the coordinated action of ataxia telangiectasia-mutated and DNA-dependent protein kinase. Cancer Res. 2001;61:8554-8563.
evidence_notes: RPA2 phosphorylation is experimentally induced after ionizing-radiation DNA damage and linked to DNA-repair regulation. This supports radiation-response interpretability but not the exact FSF constant state in tardigrades.

citation: Maremonti E, Eide DM, Rossbach LM, et al. In vivo assessment of reactive oxygen species production and oxidative stress effects induced by chronic exposure to gamma radiation in Caenorhabditis elegans. Free Radic Biol Med. 2020;152:583-596.
evidence_notes: Gamma irradiation experimentally increased ROS and activated antioxidant defenses including SOD1 in C. elegans. This supports gamma-response relevance but does not validate the FSF Stable Down direction in R. varieornatus.

citation: Kim HJ, Yun J, Lee J, et al. SUMO1 attenuates stress-induced ROS generation by inhibiting NADPH oxidase 2. Biochem Biophys Res Commun. 2011;410:555-562.
evidence_notes: Heat shock experimentally increased SUMO1 conjugation and SUMO1-dependent protection from heat-associated ROS and cell death. SMT3 is interpreted as a SUMO-family annotation; this supports heat-stress relevance but not the exact FSF constant state.

citation: Karashima Y, Talavera K, Everaerts W, et al. TRPA1 acts as a cold sensor in vitro and in vivo. Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A. 2009;106:1273-1278.
evidence_notes: Experimental work demonstrated cold activation and cold-sensing functions for mammalian TRPA1. TRPA1 thermosensory behavior is species- and context-dependent, so this is supporting interpretability only and does not validate the tardigrade FSF Up direction.

citation: Dumont AA, Dumont L, Berthiaume J, Auger-Messier M. p38alpha MAPK proximity assay reveals a regulatory mechanism of alternative splicing in cardiomyocytes. Biochim Biophys Acta Mol Cell Res. 2019;1866:118557.
evidence_notes: SRSF3 was experimentally identified in the activated p38alpha interaction network under osmotic stress and its localization/splicing activity was regulated by p38 signaling. This supports osmotic-stress relevance but not the FSF Up direction in tardigrades.

citation: Rossi M, Demidov ON, Anderson CW, et al. Induction of PPM1D following DNA-damaging treatments through a conserved p53 response element coincides with a shift in the use of transcription initiation sites. Nucleic Acids Res. 2008;36:7168-7180.
evidence_notes: PPM1D transcription was experimentally induced after ultraviolet and ionizing-radiation genotoxic stress. This supports UV-response interpretability but does not validate the FSF Transitional Down direction in R. varieornatus.

citation: Zhao Y, Zhang CF, Rossiter H, et al. Autophagy is induced by UVA and promotes removal of oxidized phospholipids and protein aggregates in epidermal keratinocytes. J Invest Dermatol. 2013;133:1629-1637.
evidence_notes: UVA experimentally induced autophagy and implicated the p62/SQSTM1 system in handling oxidatively damaged proteins and lipids. This supports UV-stress interpretability but does not validate the FSF Stable Up direction in tardigrades.
